Invite students

Invite settings

Add the web address where this app is hosted (for example your Vercel or GitHub Pages link) so the links open for your students.

Individual links

Pick any app or link just for this student, for example only the BIM material or only TED talks. They appear in a “⭐ Just for you” hub on the student's page, next to any hubs they are in. TED talks never reach students automatically: they only get the ones you pick here or put in a bundle.

Remove links

Everything this student gets, hub by hub. Untick an app to take it away from this student only: the hub and your other students are not affected. A link that is in two of their hubs is shown only once, in the first hub (marked “duplicate” below), so you don't need to remove duplicates by hand.
